Temporal focus:

T2. Forward-looking reporting short-term risks (next few weeks/months) [YES] — Ongoing 2026 drought conditions, reservoir storage levels, immediate enforcement gaps
T3. Forward-looking reporting long-term risks (next quarters/years) [YES] — Climate stress, water competition, call for national water resilience plan

Synopsis:
Guardian analysis reveals 140+ English golf clubs breached water abstraction licences over 2021–2025, with over a third taking water illegally. Despite 100 breaches posing environmental risk, zero prosecutions or fines were issued. The article surfaces against a backdrop of England's worst recorded drought (70%+ in drought, nine reservoirs critically low), raising acute questions about water allocation priorities, regulatory enforcement effectiveness, and long-term water resilience planning under accelerating climate stress.
